name: Rankcrew
description: REST resources that create multilingual nodes (with base64 images) from the RankCrew platform.
project_description:
RankCrew AI work for you: this module lets RankCrew drop ready-to-publish, multilingual articles, complete with images and SEO text, straight into your Drupal site while you sip your coffee.

 Features 
 Hands-free publishing – RankCrew writes the content and sends it directly to your site; you just watch new posts appear.

 Works with any content type – Blog, News, Recipes, you name it. Tell RankCrew the type you use and the module fills it in.

 Automatic translations – One push from RankCrew can create English, French, German, or any other language versions in a single go.

 Images included – Photos arrive with the story and land in the image field you already have.

 No extra tweaking – Turn the module on, point RankCrew to it, and you’re done.

 Quick-Start Setup (5 minutes) 
 Install RankCrew module and the REST UI module from Drupal.org.

 Turn them on

 Go to Configuration → Web services → REST, find “RankCrew”, tick Enable, allow POST, choose “basic” (or “cookie”) sign-in, and leave JSON checked.

 Full documentation here: https://www.rankcrew.ai/documentation 

 Additional Requirements 
 Just Drupal core plus the free REST UI helper.

 Community Documentation 
 https://www.rankcrew.ai/documentation 

 Enjoy effortless, AI-powered publishing!
